actual_tool_job.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Return one corrected complete portrait card. Image1 exact rejected full-resolution editing target; Image2 unchanged original small card controls exact PRIMARY pose, actual accessory location, hair, clothes, crop and light; Image3 mascot identity/anatomy only. Correct ONLY the tiny GOLD lapel mark location. Editing target wrongly places this gold mark on IMAGE-RIGHT beside/near the cream note. REMOVE that wrong-side mark completely and restore uninterrupted matching navy suit fabric there. Place ONE TINY understated nonliteral GOLD source mark on the IMAGE-LEFT lapel, AWAY FROM THE NOTE, at actual original small-card location/extent. Image-left and image-right mean viewer canvas sides, not subject anatomical sides. Do not duplicate the mark, enlarge it, invent readable engraving or mirror/rotate the whole person to move it. Preserve exact PRIMARY IMAGE-LEFT three-quarter/near-frontal angle and roll, compact broad rounded yellow head and short U lower base, minimal broad coherent raised shirt-collar contact, short dark swept/side-parted hair with actual grey temples, real dark eyebrow HAIR and thick dark upper-lip moustache, CLEAN smooth chin and serious small CLOSED mouth. Keep OPEN dark navy/black suit, pale pointed shirt, RED/BURGUNDY long tie, source crop/light and OPAQUE BLUE-GREY photo backing. No new headwear, spectacles, beard, medals, neck shaft, V throat, pinched/floating fabric or cream bib. Preserve full tilted dark rim and actual cream lower-right note overlap. All solid surfaces opaque, genuine alpha only outside complete whole-card silhouette. Fine note/pin detail understated, no invented readable text.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
